message.content: {"note_claim": "The video's narration falsely claims some 9/11 hijackers survived and were victims of identity theft; the FBI confirmed all 19 died in the crashes.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Al-Qaeda suicide operatives hijacked and crashed United Airlines Flight 175 and American Airlines Flight 11 into the twin towers of the World Trade Center and crashed American Airlines Flight 77 into the Pentagon.", "reason": "The page establishes the accepted account of al-Qaeda suicide hijackers and that conspiracy theories are debunked, but the visible text never mentions surviving hijackers, identity theft, or an FBI confirmation that all 19 died."}

parsed.note_claim: The video's narration falsely claims some 9/11 hijackers survived and were victims of identity theft; the FBI confirmed all 19 died in the crashes.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Al-Qaeda suicide operatives hijacked and crashed United Airlines Flight 175 and American Airlines Flight 11 into the twin towers of the World Trade Center and crashed American Airlines Flight 77 into the Pentagon.
parsed.reason: The page establishes the accepted account of al-Qaeda suicide hijackers and that conspiracy theories are debunked, but the visible text never mentions surviving hijackers, identity theft, or an FBI confirmation that all 19 died.
